Our journey through Chiniot, Pakistan continues as we explore the magnificent Umar Hayat Mahal, one of the finest architectural landmarks of undivided Punjab. Built in the early 20th century by Sheikh Umar Hayat, this breathtaking palace is now a public library but still showcases the incredible craftsmanship that made Chiniot famous. Construction began in 1923 and the palace became known for its remarkable woodwork and architecture. 1
